messages:
tay: Heads up - after the latest MSI I see redwoodctl auth keep retrying on startup when my profiles dir is a symlink to OneDrive. It keeps prompting for login every 30s.
ophelia: That sounds like the token file watcher can't follow the symlink? Can you share how your profiles dir is symlinked?
tay: I moved `%APPDATA%\\Redwood` to `D:\\OneDrive\\redwood` and created a junction with `mklink /J "%APPDATA%\\Redwood" "D:\\OneDrive\\redwood"`.
trent: Junctions vs symlinks are different. We had a bug where Windows file watcher falls back to polling and the auth refresh goroutine races with file writes, causing repeated 401s then forced prompt.
tay: Here's a short log excerpt:
```
[2024-08-03T09:12:01Z] profile load: C:\\Users\\tay\\AppData\\Roaming\\Redwood\\profiles\\dev.json
[2024-08-03T09:12:01Z] token: read OK
[2024-08-03T09:12:31Z] auth: refresh failed 401 invalid_token
[2024-08-03T09:12:31Z] ui: prompting interactive login
[2024-08-03T09:13:01Z] auth: refresh attempt
```
emily: Is this only when the config lives on OneDrive? Any difference if it's a plain NTFS folder?
tay: If I copy the profile dir back to C: directly it stops. So seems tied to cloud provider junctions.
ophelia: Filing RDW-DEVEX-1304: Auth refresh flapping when profiles dir is junction/synced folder. Labels: windows, auth, dx. Link: https://redwood.internal/issue/RDW-DEVEX-1304
ci-bot: CI pipeline triggered: devex/issue-1304-unit-tests (running)
trent: Short-term mitigation: add a debounce on the auth refresh goroutine and treat transient file-watcher misses as non-fatal. Also improve error message to say "check if profiles dir is on cloud/synced drive".
tay: Workaround that helped: set REDWOODCTL_CONFIG_DIR to a local path and restart. No more flapping.
ophelia: Could we also update the installer doc to warn about junctions for %APPDATA%? That might reduce support tickets.
emily: I'll add a one-liner to docs and create a small troubleshooting snippet for Windows: how to set REDWOODCTL_CONFIG_DIR and verify token reading with `redwoodctl auth status --profile dev`.
tay: Thanks. If someone from eng-cli wants my repro VM I can share a snapshot.
trent: I'll take the bug and add a regression test that runs with junctioned paths on Windows agent. Assigning to eng-cli.
ophelia: Adding note: make sure the CLI respects explicit `--profile` and env var precedence even when config dir resolution fails.
tay: Great. Leaving final logs in the ticket and marking workaround validated. :white_check_mark:
